title: The 5 Best Pet Cameras for Dogs With Separation Anxiety
h1: The 5 Best Pet Cameras for Dogs With Separation Anxiety
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for pet cameras for dogs with separation anxiety, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pet cameras for dogs with separation anxiety using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Petcube Bites 2
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p HD video with 160° full-room view, Built-in treat dispenser with adjustable toss distance, 4-microphone array with 2-way audio.
strengths: Treat dispenser gives a concrete way to reward calm moments during a departure, not just talk
4-microphone array picks up whining and barking more reliably than single-mic cameras
Alexa built-in allows hands-free check-ins and treat dispensing from any Echo device
160° view covers more of a room than a fixed 110° lens, useful for pacing dogs
limitations: Treat hopper needs refilling every few days with regular use
features: Built-in treat dispenser with adjustable toss distance

products.name: Ring Indoor Cam (2nd Gen)
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p HD video with color night vision, 115° horizontal field of view, Two-way talk.
strengths: Two-way talk is clear enough for a dog to recognize an owner's voice from across the room
Motion alerts fire quickly enough to catch the start of pacing or whining
Compact plug-in body means it can sit near a dog's usual resting spot
limitations: No pet-specific AI, alerts trigger on any movement including shadows or a ceiling fan
Saving clips for later review requires a Ring Protect subscription
115° field of view misses dogs that wander into adjacent rooms
features: 1080p HD video with color night vision

products.name: Wyze Cam Pan v3
products.blurb: Key specs: 360° pan / 180° tilt coverage, 1080p color night vision, 2-way audio.
strengths: Full pan and tilt range follows a dog that paces between rooms instead of staying in frame
Motion tracking automatically re-centers on a moving dog without manual adjustment
Works fully without a subscription for live view and short event clips
Lowest price of the pan/tilt cameras in this list
limitations: No treat dispenser for interactive rewards
Two-way audio is noticeably thinner than the Petcube's 4-microphone array
Cloud storage for longer clips needs the optional Cam Plus plan
features: Motion tracking that follows movement around the room
No subscription required for live view and basic alerts

products.name: TP-Link Tapo C210
products.blurb: Key specs: 2K resolution, 360° pan / 114° tilt, Motion detection with tracking, 2-way audio with built-in siren.
strengths: Sharpest image in this list at 2K resolution, useful for reading subtle body language
Local microSD storage avoids a mandatory subscription to review footage later
Motion tracking keeps a moving dog centered in frame
limitations: No treat dispenser or interactive feeding option
114° tilt range is narrower than the Wyze Cam Pan's full 180°
App setup takes a few more steps than Ring's for first-time smart camera users
features: Works with Alexa and Google Assistant

products.name: Furbo 360° Dog Camera
limitations: Advanced alerts need a paid plan
Treat size must fit the dispenser

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
